page.overview:
Who is Moody Root?

Moody Root is a male Earth pony and supporting character in the hour-long special My Little Pony: Rainbow Roadtrip. He is a resident of Hope Hollow and next-door neighbor of Mr. and Mrs. Hoofington.__TOC__

Later, when Pinkie Pie expresses interest in Moody Root's apricot trees from the Hoofingtons' backyard, he catches her through a knothole in his fence and tells her to stay away from his trees. Fluttershy convinces him to share his fruit with his next-door neighbors to make apricot pies. He agrees and rekindles his friendship with the Hoofingtons. After taste-testing their pies, he and the Hoofingtons bring a cart of apricot pies to serve at the Rainbow Festival to the town center, where he asks Petunia Petals for cookbooks.

Moody Root is a character in Gameloft's mobile game, added in the "Rainbow Roadtrip" event.

Moody Root grows the best apricots in Hope Hollow--and gets quite grumpy if anyone gets near his tree. Maybe he could be persuaded to share...
